name: GoalRecord
sig: export interface GoalRecord { /** Stable, runtime-assigned identifier; never reused or renumbered. */ id: string; /** Parent goal ID; absent for the root. */ parent?: string; /** Concise description of the work. The root preserves the user's prompt verbatim. */ statement: string; /** Optional observable completion conditions. */ done_when?: string; /** For children: what this goal contributes to its parent. */ contributes?: string; /** Where the goal came from. */ origin: GoalOrigin; status: GoalStatus; /** Compact report recorded when the attempt ends. */ outcome?: string; }

name: NewGoal
sig: export interface NewGoal { parent?: string; statement: string; done_when?: string; contributes?: string; origin: GoalOrigin; status?: GoalStatus; outcome?: string; }
